claims.sentence: <jats:title>Abstract</jats:title> <jats:p>The study aimed to examine the parameters of turkey ejaculates (n=40) of high and low quality (HQ and LQ, respectively), preserved with the addition of taurine (TAU; 5 mM, 10 mM) and ergothioneine (EGT; 5 mM, 10 mM) for 48 h at 5°C in a liquid state.
